integrity: All-n proof via an explicit strict weighted potential; independent finite forward BFS and reverse Dijkstra checks. No independent mathematical audit or external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The formula concerns an initial unordered pair in the stated Cerny automaton, positive letter costs and all \(n\ge3\). It does not settle full-automaton weighted reset costs, zero-cost inputs, larger subsets, or general automata; a prior implicit result in the known pair-automaton representation is an originality risk.
title: Cost-invariant unique optimal merging words for every pair of Černý states
